headline: Latest on Iran War
summary: President Donald Trump said US forces will keep hitting Iran 'very hard' in the coming period, according to an Associated Press report carried by News Talk WBAP.
why: The US-Iran conflict is a major geopolitical risk for oil supply and Gulf shipping, which affect energy prices and inflation expectations worldwide.

source.name: News Talk WBAP 820 AM and 93.3 FM

sources.name: News Talk WBAP 820 AM and 93.3 FM

why_moved: Continued military strikes raise the risk of further disruption to Middle East energy supply, which tends to lift oil prices and risk premia.
